description: Delta room administration. A new 0x03 note omits the member list (member count 65535) and records one subject. The last 32 bytes are the parent group id, or 32 zero bytes when the room is not a channel. Full-list notes stay in vectors/group-admin-v1.json. Legacy 0x06 actions 1-4 stay in vectors/group-v1.json. Fill-byte addresses are test ids, not Algorand checksums. A transaction id is 32 bytes of one fill value, except the 256-member basis head, which is a counted id. draft_errors reject a 257th member and forged channel actions.
